title: Application Settings
description: Common setting.xml keys for solution path, base URL, and feature flags

sections.title: Paths & URLs
sections.description: Solution directory and application base URL

fields.name: efwSolution
fields.label: EFW Solution
fields.description: Path to the solution resources directory. Can be changed while the application is running.

fields.name: BaseUrl
fields.label: Base URL
fields.description: Application entry URL used for links, redirects, and email resource generation.

fields.name: defaultBaseurl
fields.label: Default Base URL
fields.description: Set to false when BaseUrl is different from the server address.

fields.name: showExperimentalFeatures
fields.label: Experimental Features / Modules
fields.description: Enables experimental modules and features in the product UI.

fields.name: enableSavedResult
fields.label: Enable Saved Result
fields.description: Allow saving and using saved report results.

fields.name: streamResponse
fields.label: Stream Response
fields.description: Stream progressive response updates to the client.

fields.name: hideDefaultLoginButtons
fields.label: Hide Default Login Buttons
fields.description: Hide the default login buttons on the login page.

fields.name: serviceSpeedLimitAlert
fields.label: Service Speed Limit Alert
fields.description: Threshold (ms) used to alert on slow service responses.

fields.name: eventBatchSize
fields.label: Event Batch Size
fields.description: How many events are grouped before being sent to the client. Values near 100 balance performance and responsiveness.

fields.name: defaultEmailResourceType
fields.label: Default Email Resource Type
fields.description: If url, server-side printing is used for email. If adhoc, HTML source is expected.
